body:
Fall break had just started, and I needed a way to relax after a couple of mean tests. On a Saturday morning, myself and 2 other friends decided to gather any drugs we could find at the time, and consume the majority. I managed to rustle up an ounce of very potent bud I had been saving, and 24 leftover cartridges of nitrous oxide. My friend A managed to scrounge up 6 hits of excellent XTC, and my friend K came through with 12 grams of mushrooms. Time: 00.00 is about 8:00 A.M.
Time: 00.00
Ingest P. Cubensis (4g). Chewed to a pulp and swallowed.
Time: 00.15
Ingest 2 hits (approx. 300mg of MDMA) of Green Chicago Bulls XTC. I had tried them several times before, with excellent results.
Time: 00.20
Smoke one joint, two cigarettes.
Time: 00.45
Smoke one bowl. With every hit I take, I feel myself smiling more and more, a general softness growing inside of me.
Time: 01.00
Definatly feeling the XTC, and small tracers have begun to form as I throw a football in the morning sun. I'm slowly puffing a joint in my friends backyard, and I notice his normally friendly dogs are keeping their distance. Maybe they know something is amiss.
Time: 01.30
My mind is being flooded with glorious thoughts. A flock of birds flew out of a tree on my friend K's propterty. As they flew, each flapping wing left a wave behind it on the orange sky. The clouds seem to be flying by, and as I sit down to take a breather, I notice that they are becoming what I would normally consider ominous. But in my current condition, they seem like giant oceans of the sky. Each bolt of lightning wraps itself around the cloud, and taps a giant drum. I realize my neck hurts as I've been looking upwards for about 10 minutes.
Time: 01.45
Time for some real fun I thought. The mushrooms and XTC were in complete synergy, rolling wave after wave of euphoria over me. With each breath my hapiness grew and grew. I sat on the top of a hill. Winds started picking up all around me, and a dull roar could be heard from the clouds. I filled a balloon with nitrous, and began inhaling and exhaling deeply. Finally, when I could breath no longer, I drop the cartridge cracker and balloon, and lay back on the soft grass. My vision was filled with deep blues and greys, and as I lay the, I began to hear a light slapping noise. I sat up, and rain started falling. I stared up wondering at theclouds how they could make so much water. Each drop on the ground seemed to leave a rings on flourescent color.
Time: 02.00 - 08.00
Incredible colors and emotion continually ran over me during this experience. I finished of the day with a Valium and Xanax,hoping to sleep till the next morning.
All in all, an astonishing trip, the kind I had always hoped forfrom this combination. Excellent.
